raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Project Management Professional with 12+ years of experience managing complex, multi- stakeholder programs across BFSI and technology domains. PMI-PMP and PMI-CPMAI certified with expertise in AI project lifecycle management, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), GRC platforms, and compliance transformation. Six Sigma Black Belt with a strong track record in process excellence. 7+ years of specialized BFSI experience covering RCSA, TPRM, KYC/AML, and regulatory compliance (FATCA, GDPR). Skilled in Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery methodologies.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Project & Program Management | Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) | GRC Platforms (Archer, Service Now GRC, Metric Stream) | Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) | Agile / Waterfall / Hybrid Delivery | RCSA & Risk Registers | KYC / AML / FATCA / GDPR | Stakeholder & Vendor Management | AI Project Lifecycle (PMI-CPMAI) | Six Sigma Process Improvement | Jira & Confluence | Customer Migration & On boarding | Compliance Transformation | RAID Log Management | Change Management
TECHNICAL SKILLS
GRC Platforms: Archer, Service Now GRC, Metric Stream Project Tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, MS Excel (Advanced Macros), MS PowerPoint, MS Word, MS Outlook Methodologies: Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid, Six Sigma DMAIC Risk & Compliance: RCSA, TPRM, KYC, AML, FATCA, GDPR, POA&Ms, RAID Log
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Project Manager / Specialist | Silicon Valley Bank, Bengaluru, India
Jul 2021 – Nov 2024
Facilitated stakeholder workshops to capture business requirements for GRC platforms including Archer, Service Now GRC, and Metric Stream.
Managed the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program, including vendor due diligence, contract risk scoring, and periodic reassessments.
Developed and managed comprehensive project plans, timelines, resource schedules, and milestones for successful migration execution.
Conducted Steering Committee and project working group meetings, presenting key updates and decisions to senior leadership.
Directed end-to-end IT infrastructure projects across global sites, including scope definition, risk

assessment, and execution. Introduced automated reporting dashboards for project and capacity management, significantly reducing manual reporting time.
Managed external vendors and implementation partners to ensure adherence to project timelines and SLAs. • Led Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) activities for a Tier-1 global banking client, integrating risk

identification and mitigation across KYC, AML, and client onboarding programs. Implemented third-party risk management framework to evaluate vendor risks across IT and compliance domains.
Partnered with internal risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to conduct RCSA (Risk and Control Self- Assessments) and maintain enterprise-wide risk registers. Identified process improvement opportunities to reduce turnaround time and operational risk.
• Delivered program milestones across Initiation, Planning, Execution, Monitoring, and Closure phases, including on boarding of impacted systems and downstream processing validation.
Directed compliance transformation initiative including vendor risk assessments and third-party risk governance.
Maintained RAID log to track risks including delays in stakeholder approvals and third-party dependencies.
Senior Analyst – Project Management & Due Diligence | HSBC Electronic Data Processing India Pvt Ltd
Jan 2017 – Jul 2021
Delivered stakeholder communications, project status reports, and solution documentation in line with HSBC governance standards.
Conducted scenario planning and risk modeling to analyze regulatory impact and business continuity during high-risk events.
Managed cross-functional teams to ensure regulatory adherence (FATCA, GDPR) and timely closure of audit findings.
Supported Workforce Management (WFM) team for scheduling and BAU operations; developed strong expertise in forecasting, AHT, shrinkage, overtime, and FTE planning.
Applied strong data mining skills to analyze Production Environment Metrics and improve operational efficiency.
Supported CRT testing team to validate tool credibility and functionality prior to launch. • Gained deep domain knowledge in anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions, and market risks across private banking, retail banking, and wealth management.
Support Associate – KYC Reviews | Convergys India Pvt Ltd
May 2015 – Dec 2016
Conducted KYC reviews for credit card customers and performed transaction monitoring in compliance with regulatory standards.
Supported procurement processes for the Avaya product line within large-scale operations and supply chain workflows.
Managed complex accounts with zero escalations and created second-level backup documentation for process continuity.
Prepared aging bucket reports and presented findings to clients; contacted customers for missing KYC information and transaction queries.
Certified KYC Specialist | Issued: Jul 2023 • Six Sigma Black Belt
